patterns.comment: In general, it should be '#wellformed-html' to parse any html content inside C# methods. However, parser breaks with that and it requires more work

blazor-component-attribute-transition-be.comment: The same as 'other' branch in text.html.basic#attribute, but with '@' before name: we can parse value as C#
blazor-component-attribute-transition-be.name: meta.attribute.blazor

blazor-component-attribute-interior.comment: Primarily equivalent to text.html.basic#attribute-interior, but supports C# expressions in attribute values

csharp-expression-non-greedy.comment: Specifically tuned C# expression parsing that will not start consuming the next quote as a string literal in unexpected places

anonymous-method-expression-non-greedy.comment: The same as source.cs#anonymous-method-expression (with updated references), but non-greedy, stops right after lambda parsing is complete and does not consume the next quote as a string literal. It contains only the lambda expression pattern and does not include the delegate pattern, since later uses block body and is already non-greedy

blazor-component-attribute-transition-in.comment: We need this rule (string.quoted injection is not enough) to get the priority over HTML parsing of onEVENT='JS code'. Plus, there is a special syntax attrName=@expression that would not be parsed otherwise

non-void-tag.comment: Exclude 'script' and 'style' tags, so standard html parsing rules are applied (and js/css is highlighted)

patterns.match:
(?x)
(?:
  (\bvar\b)|
  (?<type-name>
    (?:
      (?:
        (?:(?<identifier>@?[_[:alpha:]][_[:alnum:]]*)\s*\:\:\s*)? # alias-qualification
        (?<name-and-type-args> # identifier + type arguments (if any)
          \g<identifier>\s*
          (?<type-args>\s*<(?:[^<>]|\g<type-args>)+>\s*)?
        )
        (?:\s*\.\s*\g<name-and-type-args>)* | # Are there any more names being dotted into?
        (?<tuple>\s*\((?:[^\(\)]|\g<tuple>)+\))
      )
      (?:\s*\?\s*)? # nullable suffix?
      (?:\s*\[(?:\s*,\s*)*\]\s*)* # array suffix?
    )
  )
)\s+
(\g<identifier>)\s+
\b(in)\b
